# {{< fa book >}} Peer-Reviewed Publications

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
library(RefManageR)

BibOptions(
  check.entries = FALSE,
  bib.style = "authoryear",
  style = "markdown",
  sorting = "ynt",
  hyperlink = FALSE,
  dashed = TRUE,
  max.names = 10,
  longnamesfirst = FALSE
)

bib <- ReadBib("assets/bib/Exported Items.bib")

get_year <- function(entry) {
  if (!is.null(entry$year) && length(entry$year) > 0) {
    return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(entry$year[[1]])))
  }

  if (!is.null(entry$date) && length(entry$date) > 0) {
    year_text <- regmatches(
      entry$date[[1]],
      regexpr("[0-9]{4}", entry$date[[1]])
    )
    return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_text)))
  }

  NA_real_
}

years <- vapply(bib, get_year, numeric(1))
order_index <- order(is.na(years), -years)

for (i in order_index) {
  entry <- capture.output(
    print(
      bib[[i]],
      .opts = list(
        style = "markdown",
        no.print.fields = c("url", "urldate")
      )
    )
  )

  cat(paste(entry, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
}
```
